title: Cosmic Serpent Orb
description: A glowing teal and magenta snake with iridescent scales is coiled inside a transparent crystalline sphere. The snake emits bright blue electrical arcs and energy while surrounded by floating rings, colorful orbs, and luminous particles against a dark cosmic background.
prompt: A luminous teal and magenta snake with intricate glowing scales coiled in an infinity shape inside a transparent crystalline sphere. The serpent has bright blue eyes and emits powerful blue electrical energy arcs from its body. Floating around it are purple rings, colorful glowing orbs, and sparkling particles. The entire scene is set against a dark swirling cosmic background with vibrant neon highlights.
